level1Regression.note: Level 1 constructs no Level 2 code. Its seeded result differs from increment 1's (101.3 s) because two wall-clock dependencies were removed (below), which changes the random sequence; Level 1 logic is unchanged.

reproducibility.correction: Increment 1 reported that seeded runs replay exactly. That was verified only for 30 s of play; full runs still diverged.
causes: events.js fired staggered tear-gas, mortar and volley shots with setTimeout (wall clock)
the dynamic-resolution system changed crowd detail (maxSkinned) from real frame times, which changed which characters animate and draw random numbers
reproducibility.fix: game-time timers in the incident scheduler; crowd detail fixed while the harness steps the simulation (normal play unchanged)
reproducibility.verification: two complete seeded Level 1 runs in separate page loads, with different slice sizes, gaps and menu idle time: identical time, score, stats, stage log, health and crowd positions
